title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — Term Commitment Pricing of the Per-Worker Fee
content:
A longer commitment discounts the per-worker fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement by the whole months from the signed date to the renewal date that ends the current term, a month counting as whole only once the day of the month of the signed date is reached, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day:

| Whole months from the signed date to the renewal date | Discount |
|---|---|
| at least 36 | 5 percent |
| at least 24 but fewer than 36 | 3 percent |
| fewer than 24 | none |

Both dates are read from the agreement record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Signed on the 15th of a month, renewal date on the 15th of the month 36 months later: 36 whole months, 5 percent.
- Signed on the 15th, renewal date on the 14th of the month 36 months later: the 15th is not reached in the last month, so 35 whole months, 3 percent.
- Signed on the 1st, renewal date on the 1st of the month 24 months later: 24 whole months, 3 percent.
- Signed on the 1st, renewal date on the 1st of the month 12 months later: 12 whole months, no term discount.
- Signed on the 31st of a month that is followed by a 30-day month: the first whole month is reached on the first day of the month after that 30-day month, the 30-day month having no 31st.
